narrative.overview: The site is a personal digital space: direct, individual, and grounded in the character of a terminal. Pixel lettering and a restrained dark palette support the work and personal material rather than turning the site into a generic corporate portfolio.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, flat surfaces with warm light text and an ember accent.
Pixel display type paired with monospaced body text.
Square edges, visible rules, and direct navigation.
Personal and authentic rather than corporate.
dos: Do preserve the site's personal identity and direct voice.
Do use existing surface tones and borders to establish hierarchy.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and the skip link.
donts: Don't turn the personal site into a generic corporate portfolio.
Don't replace the established flat, square visual language with ornamental shadows or rounded surfaces without a deliberate design decision.
